classification.rationale: Video transcript from a media channel discussing extraordinary claims about UFO programs, psychic summoning, and clandestine operations. Contains unverified whistleblower testimony and references to classified materials. While the text itself is public, the sensational nature and unclear custodial chain of the underlying evidence warrant human review before ingestion.
